title: Assigning and Reassigning a Variable
description: See how assigning a new value to pizzas replaces the old value stored in that variable.

steps.description: Store the number 3 in the variable pizzas on line 1 and print its value on line 2.

steps.question: What happens to the 3 stored in pizzas when line 3 runs pizzas = 5?
steps.answer: The assignment pizzas = 5 replaces the 3 in pizzas with 5, so line 4 prints 5.

steps.description: Reassign pizzas = 5 on line 3 and print pizzas again on line 4.
Watch pizzas update from 3 to 5 in memory before the second print statement runs.
